_comment: Awin feeds used by Travel Gear World. advertiserId is the Awin advertiser id (file names AWIN_<advertiserId>_<feedId>.csv.gz in the Awin archive). Without feedIds, every file of that retailer is read. Add a retailer only after Awin has approved the programme. First version (22 Oct 2026): the two approved retailers already on Car Gear World that also sell luggage, travel accessories and camping gear. More retailers are added after the travel feed scan (tools/travel-feed-scan.ps1). retailer is the name shown on the site; VEVOR has the NL flag (site.config.js retailerCountries).

sources._comment: Case Luggage (approved 26 Oct 2026, feed 110976, 1,452 products on 27 Oct 2026): a luggage specialist since 1923 (Samsonite, TUMI, Briggs & Riley). The whole shop is travel, so travelShop gives every product travel context; the VGW rules still decide the category and keep wallets, belts and other non-travel items out. Loaded on its own with vgw-cloudflare -Only 121020 (lessons L34).
